title: Series Bible
description: Cross-episode canon for a series. Lives at projects/_series/<series_id>/series_bible.json with its own history/ archives. Episodes are ordinary projects/<slug>/ productions; the bible is what carries locked assets, style, and laws between them. BINDING per skills/meta/series-continuity.md.

series_id.description: Kebab-case series slug — the directory name under projects/_series/.

title_locked.description: false = working title, Director has not ratified it yet.

premise.description: What the series is, in one paragraph — the show's engine, not one episode's plot.

format.description: The default brief seed for every episode. Episode intake pre-fills from here; Director overrides are logged per episode and recorded in episodes[].divergences.

style.description: Visual style verbatim from the founding episode's brief — the series look.

canon.description: Locked cross-episode assets. An episode's stage 7 IMPORTS these as pre-locked elements and only generates what is genuinely new. New elements locked during an episode are PROMOTED here at episode close.

derived_sheets.description: State-variant references (goggles-down, bare-wrist…) that survived an episode and remain useful.

voice_presets.description: Provider voice presets in use (Higgsfield seed_audio etc.) — preset ids drive new line generation; locked samples in canon drive video-model voice conditioning.

laws.description: Standing craft/process rules that carry across episodes, each anchored to its decision id in the founding episode's decision log.

slug.description: The projects/<slug>/ directory of this episode's production.

divergences.description: Director-approved departures from format/canon in this episode, with decision ids.

continuity_notes.description: What the NEXT episode must know: end state, running gags, promises made to the audience.

spotlight.description: Stage-12 series carry-over: the show set and direct-address conventions.

show_set_element_id.description: Canon location used as the recurring spotlight/direct-address set.

element_id.description: Stable id (CH01, LOC01, OBJ03…) — identical across episodes.

source_episode_slug.description: Episode whose production locked this element; its lock_descriptors entry is the descriptor of record.

sheet_path.description: Path relative to the SOURCE episode's project dir.

media_id.description: Provider media/job id of the locked sheet/plate/sample.

public_url.description: Stable public URL (CloudFront) usable as a cross-provider reference.

voice_sample_media_id.description: Characters only: locked voice sample conditioning the video model.
